heading: Today
text: A few high level clouds, otherwise mostly sunny. Highs from the upper 40s to mid-50s. Light north wind occasionally gusting 10 to 15 mph.

heading: Tonght
text: Partly cloudy and cool. Lows in the 20s, a few teens possible in the north and the coldest valleys. Wind diminishing to calm overnight.

heading: Saturday
text: A few morning clouds, then mostly sunny skies. Highs in the 50s, nearing 60 in the warmer valleys. Light and variable wind.
